English: We conducted a systematic literature search of the effects of 102 technologies, including farm management practices (e.g., leguminous intercropped agroforestry, increased protein content of livestock diets, etc.), on 57 indicators consistent with CSA goals (e.g., yield, water use efficiency, carbon sequestration, etc.) as part of an effort called the “CSA Compendium”.
Luganda: Twanoonya ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku bireeteddwa tekinologiya wa mirundi 102, omuli enkola z’endabirira ya faamu (okugeza okutabikamu emiti egireeta obugimu, okwongeza ku puloteni mu mmere y’ensolo, n’ebirala), ku birazi 57 ebikwatagana obulungi n’ebiruubirirwa bya CSA (okugeza, ebikungulwa, enkozesa y’amazzi ennungi, entereka ya kaboni, n’ebirala) ng’ekitundu ku kaweefube ayitibwa“CSA Compendium”.

English: Even though there are many research projects about “climate smart” agriculture in eastern and southern Africa, most of them focus on only a few of the many possible options.

English: Furthermore, the researchers found that only a small percentage of studies (3.5%) focused on livestock.
Luganda: Ekirala, abanoonyereza baakizuula nti okunoonyereza kutono nnyo (3.5%) okwatunuulira ebisolo.

English: In terms of the 3 climate smart goals, the researchers said that more than 80% of the studies focused on increasing farm productivity, while only 17.5% were about helping farmers adapt to climate change, and only 0.5% were about how to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
Luganda: Bwe tutunuulira ebiruubirirwa 3 eby’okukuuma obutonde, abanoonyereza baagamba nti ebitundu ebisukka mu 80% eby’okunoonyereza byali bikwata ku kwongera bifunibwa mu faamu, so ng’ebitundu 17.5% byokka bye byali ku kuyamba abalimi okutambula n’enkyukakyuka mu mbeera y’obudde, ate ebitundu 0.5% byali ku ngeri y’okukendeezaamu ebikka eby’obulabe ebifulumizibwa.
Yoruba: Ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú àfojúsùn ìṣàkóso ìlò ilẹ̀ 3, àwọn àṣewádìí náà sọ pé iṣẹ́ ìwádìí tó ju 80% lọ ló dá lé bí òkò wọn ṣe ń bí s, tí 17.5% nìkan ló dá lé bí wọ́n ṣe lè ran àwọn àgbẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ lórí bí wọ́n ṣe lè ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú àyípadà tí ó máa ń dé bá ojú-ọjọ́, tí 0.5% nìkan dá lé bí wọn ṣe lè dín ìtújáde gáàsì ilé gírínì.

English: The findings give other scientists important insights into how climate smart practices are being implemented across the region.

English: They added that looking at data across multiple studies could also help scientists understand the effects of specific climate smart practices on a larger scale, as well as whether certain practices lead to trade-offs between different climate smart goals.

Hausa: Binciken ya kasance na haɗin gwiwa ne a tsakanin masana kimiyya da suke aiki a Netherlands da Kenya da Italiya da USA da kuma Jamhuriyar Demokraɗiyyar Kongo.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše e bile tirišano magareng ga bašomi ba tša mahlale bao ba šomago ka Netherlands, Kenya, Italy, USA le ba ka Democratic Republic of Congo.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በኔዘርላንድስ፣ በኬንያ፣ በጣሊያን፣ በአሜሪካ እና በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ በሚሰሩ ሳይንቲስቶች መካከል የተደረገ ትብብር ነበር።
